fields.label: Delivery Note
fields.description: The order-level Delivery Note. Multi-box orders intentionally have one Pack Verify record per AWB.

fields.label: AWB scanned
fields.description: UNIQUE — every physical parcel is verified and photographed exactly once.

fields.label: Printed in batch
fields.description: Ties a CS complaint back to the wave AND (via the batch's output_parts line ranges) to the packing line that packed it.

fields.label: Station / Line
fields.description: Which packing line verified this (Line 1-4). Set from the device the packer uses.

fields.label: WMS Pack Handoff
fields.description: One-time completed-pick evidence consumed when the opt-in WMS pack gate is active.

fields.label: Pieces expected
fields.description: System count of physical pieces (Product Bundles exploded to components) — the same number Section B of the pick list prints.

fields.label: Pieces counted
fields.description: What the packer actually counted into the box.

fields.label: COUNT MISMATCH
fields.description: Counted != expected. Recorded rather than rejected — a caught short-pack is the whole point of the control.

fields.label: Photo of open box
fields.description: Evidence shot of the open box before sealing. Settles a CS 'item missing' dispute outright, and covers SKUs with no barcode and combo parts pre-nested at goods-inward.

fields.label: Contents (snapshot)
fields.description: The exact piece list shown to the packer at verify time — frozen, so a later item-master edit can never rewrite what was on screen.

fields.label: Seconds taken
fields.description: Scan-to-submit time. The pilot's cost side: paper QC is ~10-15s per multi-item box.
